content.question: What is the goal of dimensionality reduction?
options: To reduce the number of features in the data while preserving as much information as possible.
To increase the number of features so that the data becomes linearly separable.
To label each data point with its nearest class.
To remove all noisy data points from the training dataset.
content.answer: To reduce the number of features in the data while preserving as much information as possible.
